executive_summary.text: Cost year 2025: direct care cost was $150.7 per resident day (45.9% of expenses); Connecticut median $174.45.

Cost year 2025: the home recorded $7,985,082 in Connecticut Medicaid revenue (after its Medicaid contractual allowance) for 24,857 Medicaid days, $321.24 per Medicaid day. DSS's Medicaid daily rate was $334.83 for July 2024 to June 2025 and $322.05 for July 2025 to June 2026.
Cost year 2025: nursing home operating margin was 11.5% (Connecticut median 2.5%).
Cost year 2025: nursing pool (agency) staff counted in direct care cost $33,942, 0.8% of the $4,460,743 direct care cost.

Cost year 2025: dietary cost $739,523, $24.98 per resident day (Connecticut median $29.51). Wages $406,087 (54.9%), allocated fringe $62,069 (8.4%), non-wage costs $271,367 (36.7%). Raw food was $258,588 ($8.74 per resident day; Connecticut median $8.61).
Cost year 2025: housekeeping cost $392,473, $13.26 per resident day (Connecticut median $12.32). Wages $320,570 (81.7%), allocated fringe $48,998 (12.5%), non-wage costs $22,905 (5.8%).
Missing data: cost years 2015, 2020 left out because the figures failed the site's checks (reasons under missing_data); Cost year 2025 laundry is not used: outside the plausible range.

findings.statement: Cost year 2025: DSS's review changed 9 line(s) of the report, a net reduction of $147,011 in the costs DSS counts. Largest: Occupational Therapy Resident Care (page 13 line B10a), removed $262,073; Other Interest Expense (page 27 line 12D), added $130,000; Other Resident Care Supplies (page 20 line 5m), removed $98,908. Separately, the home itself removed $575,061 from the costs it claimed (for example bad debt, pharmacy or therapy that the daily rate does not cover). The data shows each change, not the reason.

The filing is still listed in financials.json.

Cost year 2020 is left out of this report: its figures failed the site's checks (direct care per resident day outside the plausible range; nursing hours per resident day outside the plausible range; core figures (days, revenue or expenses) could not be read; payer days do not add up to the printed total; resident_days: resident days missing). The filing is still listed in financials.json.
Cost year 2025 laundry is not used: outside the plausible range.

definitions.wages_reported: Salaries and wages printed on the cost report for that department. Not total department spending.
definitions.total_department_cost: Wages + allocated fringe + non-salary costs for the department, as computed by the site's cost-report build.
definitions.direct_care: DSS rate-setting definition: nursing and aide salaries, related fringe (allocated), and nursing pool (agency) cost.
definitions.figures: As filed by the home before DSS audit. Not Medicaid-allowable costs.
definitions.data_quality: Per year: status validated (core figures present, payer days add up, nothing out of range), unvalidated (read, but printed totals did not fully reconcile: treat as provisional) or check_failed (core figures missing or implausible: not used in reports). unusable_fields lists figures in that year that should not be quoted, with the reason.
definitions.raw_food_per_resident_day: Raw food cost / resident days. Only shown when the home buys its own food; when a contractor supplies meals the raw-food line is not comparable.
